name: Anxious Imp
subtitle: conduit of compulsion
rules: OBSESS -- COST – Pay 2. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains "PROVIDES – [O][O][O]". -- [O][O][O][O][O][O] – This card gains COVERT.

name: Concentriculation
subtitle: on the frontier of focus
rules: COST – Pick a non-resource card. -- EFFECT – Put the card on the top of its owner's deck. -- RECUR – [O][O][O] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 3. Pick a character. Remove this card from the game. -- EFFECT – Put the character into its owner's hand.
flavor: Take a picture, it'll last longer!
notes: Card prints COST –; catalog has newer EXTRA COST: templating. Footer also credits 'original Open R&D concept by Chalalite'.

name: Contiguous Defalcating Machine
subtitle: not quite what it sounds like
rules: UNIQUE CONTIGUOUS DEFALCATING MACHINE -- If a character enters play, its controller must choose one of the following: -- OPTION 1 -- Put a resource they control into its owner's hand. -- OPTION 2 -- Destroy that character. -- OPTION 3 -- Their faction loses 3 influence.
flavor: ...but exactly what it means.
notes: Catalog typo "owners's" (card prints "owner's").

name: Elementary Elemental
subtitle: adorably horrible
rules: If this card is destroyed, put it into its owner's hand, then discard a card.
flavor: Little Suzy suspected that today would have been a good day to stay home from the Arcanology Academy.
notes: Card prints "If this card is destroyed"; catalog uses newer "When" templating. Footer also credits 'original Open R&D concept by kallisti'.

name: Expedition Endeavour
subtitle: is that a bear?
rules: Choose one of the following as this card's rules text: -- OPTION 1 -- COST – Your opponent may detach up to 3 resources. -- EFFECT – You may search your deck for an Arcanist character and reveal it. If you do, put it into your hand. -- OPTION 2 -- COST – Choose a number for X. Deplete X characters you control. -- EFFECT – Detach X+3 resources from your faction. -- OPTION 3 -- COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains COVERT.
flavor: A group of bad men looking for a very bad thing.
notes: Card prints COST – and "Your opponent may detach"; catalog has EXTRA COST: and "An opponent" (updated templating).

name: Forgotten Tentacle
subtitle: an appendaged afterthought
rules: COST – Pick an opponent. Look at that player's face-down resources and pick one. -- EFFECT – You may destroy that card. If you do, that player may draw a card and may play a resource.
notes: Card prints COST –; catalog has newer EXTRA COST: templating. Footer also credits 'original Open R&D concept by Grobi'.

name: Gloamspike-Gosche Bridge
subtitle: the arcane crossing
rules: This card cannot be picked. -- All characters in your hand gain TACTICAL. -- [O][O][O][O][O][O][O][O] – All items and locations in your hand gain TACTICAL.
flavor: An invisible bridge stretches the passage between mainland Clockman and the isolated towers of the Clockman Arcanology Branch
notes: Flavor has no closing period on the card.

name: Lugubrian Poacher
subtitle: hoarse hunter of horrors
rules: If this card restores, it gains COVERT this turn.
flavor: The wastelands of Lugubria were never hospitable, but decades of voidal pollution have made them host to many dangerous monsters. In a strange twist, the arcanists have begun to find uses for these beasts and will pay bounties to anyone foolish enough to pursue them. He who fights with monsters might take care lest he thereby become a monster.
notes: Card prints "If this card restores"; catalog uses newer "When" templating.

name: Man Shark
subtitle: distant relative of the land shark
rules: This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each face-down resource each opponent controls. -- FOLLOW SUIT -- COST – Pay 3. Pick an opponent. -- EFFECT – That player puts a card from their hand face-down as a resource under their control.
flavor: The blur is intentional, we know there are just some things you can't un-see...
notes: Flavor text is deliberately blurred on the card; reading is best effort (ending punctuation uncertain, appears to be a period or ellipsis).

name: Mittens of Muffled Thought
subtitle: can't brain so good today
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character cannot attack and has no rules text. -- MOVE -- COST – Pick a character that is not in battle. Pay 3. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character.
flavor: I dumb!?

name: Monstrous Lassitude
subtitle: ennui embodied
rules: When this card comes into play, on your next turn, skip your faction's RESTORE RULE. -- [V][V][V][V] – This card loses all other rules text.
flavor: The Thabbashite mages of Lugubria have been known to "enlist" the services of horrific creatures of titanic proportions to do their bidding.

name: Neuralyzer Agent
subtitle: please look here
rules: If this card attacks, pick an opponent. That player discards a card. -- [O][O][O][O][O][O] – If this card inflicts battle damage to an opponent's faction, that faction's owner discards a card.
flavor: There was no ectoplasmic voidal horror, only a pocket of swamp gas that reflected the light of a celestial sphere.
notes: Card prints "If" in both abilities; catalog uses newer "When" templating.

name: Officially Offensive Overseer
subtitle: more offensive than official
rules: COST – If you control at least [O][O][O], you may pick a character or a location. -- When this card enters play, if you picked a character or location as part of its cost and the character has strength 3 or less or the location has structure 3 or less, put that card into its owner's hand.
flavor: but less officious than offensive.
notes: Card prints COST –; catalog has newer EXTRA COST: templating. Catalog typo "owners's".

name: Ping Konk
subtitle: hargantuan gorror
flavor: Don't kill it... it just wants to hug its mommy!
notes: No rules text on the card (matches catalog).

name: Quotidian Concealer
subtitle: look what I had for breakfast
rules: This card enters play with a token on it. -- OBSCURE -- COST – Remove a token from this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains COVERT.
flavor: Being able to actually see inside people was a massive step forward in Luridian medicine - and Imperical torture.

name: Quotidian Transposition
subtitle: whoops
rules: Each player picks a character they own and puts it into their hand.

name: Study Disturbance
subtitle: glomp
rules: COST – Pick a player. -- EFFECT – That player may pay 2. If they do, look at the top card of your deck then terminate this card. Otherwise, that player cannot play characters this turn. Draw a card.
flavor: There's been a change of priorities.
notes: Card prints the 'That player may pay 2 ... terminate this card' decision as part of the EFFECT (resolves on effect); catalog moves it into EXTRA COST (pay-2 / terminate happens as a cost, timing change) and drops the 'Otherwise' branch. Net outcome looks equivalent but timing differs, so flagged different for triage.

name: Tedious TriAdic Truculence
subtitle: touch them with terror
rules: COST – Pick 3 characters with different names. -- EFFECT – Any opponent may pay 3. If they do, look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back in any order then terminate this card. Otherwise, destroy each picked character with 3 strength or less.
flavor: They try to teach the truth through the training of threes.
notes: Card requires picking 3 characters WITH DIFFERENT NAMES; catalog says only 'Pick 3 characters'. Also the opponent's 'may pay 3' is in the EFFECT on the card but moved into EXTRA COST in the catalog (timing change).

name: Thabbashite Chemist
subtitle: the living gods call for potent magics
rules: DELINIATE – [V][V] -- COST – Pay 2. Deplete this card. Choose a threshold type. X is that type. -- EFFECT – This turn, each face-down resource that doesn't have "PROVIDES – X", gains "PROVIDES – X".
notes: Card prints 'Choose a threshold type. X is that type.'; catalog has 'Name a threshold icon. X is that icon.' (updated templating).

name: The Lugubrian Council of Quotidian Affairs
subtitle: we need a god to study and exploit... all in favor say "aye"!
rules: UNIQUE COUNCIL -- CONVENE -- COST – Pay 2. Discard 2 cards. -- EFFECT – Put 2 tokens on this card. -- CAST VOTE -- COST – Pay 2. Remove 2 tokens from this card. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a tactic and reveal it. Put it into your hand. -- PASS -- COST – Pay 2. Discard a tactic from your hand. X is that tactic's numeric cost. Pick an opponent's character with strength X or less. -- EFFECT – Put the character into its owner's hand. That character's controller may detach up to X resources from their faction.

name: This, That, and the Other Thing
subtitle: too much pot spoils the cook
rules: COST – Pick 3 tactics in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Shuffle 1 card into your deck. Put 1 card into play under your control as a face-down resource. Put 1 card into your hand.
flavor: Ooh! one of these, and one of those... Yuck! that one is rotten.
notes: Card prints COST –; catalog has EXTRA COST: templating. Card says '1 card' where catalog says '1 of the tatics' (clarifies the picked tactics; catalog also has typo 'tatics'). Footer also credits 'original Open R&D concept by dzilla'.

name: Underwhelming Performance
subtitle: the fix is in
rules: COST – Pick a character. That character's controller my detach up to 2 resources. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character loses 6 strength. Draw a card.
flavor: Sometimes the Mau have the right idea. (but don't tell them we said that!)
notes: Card prints COST – and has a typo 'my detach' (should be 'may'); catalog has EXTRA COST: and 'may'. Flavor is in very small print.

name: Undevoted Gargantuan
subtitle: disloyal devourer
rules: COVERT -- When this card enters play, each opponent may detach up to 3 resources from their faction.
flavor: What the hell man? Same team, same team!

name: Violating Ritual
subtitle: this may sting a little
rules: COST – Pick an opponent. -- EFFECT – That opponent discards 2 cards. Draw a card.
notes: Card prints COST –; catalog has newer EXTRA COST: templating.

name: Voidal Trinket
subtitle: not sure what it does
rules: AUGUR -- COST – Deplete this card. Choose a number for X that is 3 or less. Pick an opponent. That opponent may detach up to X resources from their faction. -- EFFECT – Look at the top X cards of your deck. You may put one of those cards on the top of your deck. Put the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: Ancient and Disreputable Law Office
subtitle: exactly as advertised
rules: UNIQUE A & D LAW -- Characters with numeric cost 2 or less cannot attack.
flavor: Have you or a loved one recently got blowed up? If so, visit the offices of Dewey, Cheatem, and Howe. Get what's yours!

name: Arcane Escrow
subtitle: keep it secret, keep it safe
rules: If you would discard a card, you may remove it from the game face-down instead. -- You may look at cards removed from the game by this card. -- If you would draw a card as part of your DEVELOP RULE, you may put a card removed from the game by this card into its owner's hand instead. -- WITHDRAW -- COST – Pay 1. -- EFFECT – Draw a card. Discard 2 cards. -- FLIP UP – 1 [G][G]
notes: Card prints 'remove it from the game' / 'removed from the game by this card'; catalog uses newer 'void' / 'voided' terminology. Footer also credits 'original Open R&D concept by kallisti'.

name: Audacious Appraisal
subtitle: whatever the market will bear
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – That character's controller chooses a number for X. Choose one: That player's faction loses X influence, or destroy the picked character and your faction loses X+X influence.
flavor: Buy when it whines, sell when it roars.
notes: Card prints COST –; catalog has newer EXTRA COST: templating.

name: Auspicious Arrival
subtitle: a red carpet reception...
rules: Look at the top 8 cards of your deck. You may choose a character among them with 1 strength or less and reveal it. If you do, put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck. -- FLIP UP – 3 [G]
flavor: ...of Questionable Morality.

name: Contractual Execution
subtitle: sleep with the fishes
rules: COST – Pick a character. That character's controller picks a resource they control. Put the resource into its owner's hand. -- EFFECT – Flip the character face down under its owner's control.
notes: Card prints COST –; catalog has newer EXTRA COST: templating. Catalog typo "owners's" (twice).

name: Enlightened Mau
subtitle: agnostic ascetic
rules: All damage assigned to this card by characters with items attached to them is reduced to 0. -- TRANSCEND -- COST – Pay 5. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains COVERT.
flavor: Money is a terrible master, but an excellent servant.

name: Eustace Padamose-Gristwalter
subtitle: the littlest litigator
typeLine: BANKER CHARACTER – eustace, blade of questionable morality
rules: UNIQUE EUSTACE -- FUTURE IMPLICATIONS -- COST – Pay 2. Your faction loses 1 influence. -- EFFECT – Draw a card. -- PAST TREPIDATIONS -- COST – Discard a card. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains 1 life. If the discarded card was a resource, this card also gains 1 strength this turn.

name: Fallen Quarter-Finalist
subtitle: he didn't make it to the semi-finals
flavor:
Fighting the fight, swinging the sword.
He slipped in the gore, a master no more.
He haunts the arena just looking for fights,
missing the cheers, the blood and the spotlights.
notes: No rules text on the card (matches catalog). Flavor is a four-line verse; newlines are the printed verse line breaks. Two artists credited.

name: Golden Charm
subtitle: draconic disc
rules: UNIQUE CHARM -- If a player would search their deck you may pay 1 instead. If you do, draw a card and then that player searches their deck. -- SERAPHIM FUSION -- COST – Pay 4. Pick a UNIQUE EUSTACE you control. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a card named "Siluriformes Flaxenscale" and put it into play.
notes: Same outcome, reworded: card says 'you may pay 1 instead. If you do, draw a card and then that player searches their deck'; catalog moves 'instead' to the end of the sentence. SERAPHIM FUSION: card says 'Pick a UNIQUE EUSTACE you control'; catalog says 'Pick a character you control with UNIQUE EUSTACE'.

name: Goldmau Sacks Representative
subtitle: doing god's work
rules: RAISE CAPITAL -- COST – Pay 1. Discard a card. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains "PROVIDES – [G][G][G]". -- INVEST – [G][G][G][G][G][G] -- COST – Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a resource and reveal it. Put it into your hand.
flavor: The first thing you need to know about Goldmau Sacks is that it's everywhere. Clockman's most powerful investment bank is a great vampire squid wrapped around the face of humanity, relentlessly jamming its blood funnel into anything that smells like money.

name: Hassan-i of Thabbash
subtitle: the living gods call for acceptance of death
rules: If this card is destroyed, each opponent must destroy a character they control. -- HARASH – [V][V][V] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile and only during your turn. Pay 1. Destroy a face-down resource you control. -- EFFECT – Put this card into play under your control.
flavor: The original Hashshashin.
notes: Card prints "If this card is destroyed"; catalog uses newer "When" templating. Footer also credits 'original Open R&D concept by GooDMaN88'.

name: Homewrecker
subtitle: assume the position
rules: COST – Inflict 2 damage to a location you own or pay 3. -- Locations you control gain 1 structure. -- PROSTRATE -- COST – Deplete a location you control. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Deplete that card.
flavor: Who's your momma?!!
notes: Card prints COST –; catalog has newer EXTRA COST: templating.

name: Impressionistic Furball
subtitle: it really captures the fluffiness, you know?
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- Attached character gains 2 life. -- COUGH UP – [G][G][G] -- COST – Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Draw a card.
flavor: Being good in business is the most fascinating kind of art. Making money is art and working is art and good business is the best art.
notes: Modifier badges print +0 STR, +0 SPD, +2 LIFE.

name: Mau Strategist
subtitle: conniving and cunning
rules: When this card enters play, you may search your deck for a staple resource, reveal it, and put it into your hand. -- If this card is destroyed, you may draw a card.
flavor: Always looking for the next task to increase his own bank account. He will risk it all just for a little more profit, even if "it all", isn't his 'it all' to risk.
notes: Card prints "If this card is destroyed"; catalog uses newer "When" templating.

name: Mr. Fetch
subtitle: only finds what you didn't know you needed
rules: UNIQUE PLUCK -- When this card enters play, you may remove a card in your discard pile from the game. If you do, draw a card. -- GOOD DEAL -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick 2 cards of the same type in your discard pile. Remove them from the game. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a card with the same type as the picked cards and reveal it. If you do, put it into your hand.

name: Mushroom Merchant
subtitle: it's dangerous to go alone, take this
rules: When this card enters play, you may pick a character. If you do, this turn, that character gains 2 life.
flavor: Buy something, will ya?

name: Negotiation Ceremonies
subtitle: more talking than I care to discuss
rules: COST – Pick an opponent. You may pay 1. If you do, that opponent may pay 1. Repeat this cost until you or your opponent does not pay. -- EFFECT – Each player draws cards equal to the amount they paid.
flavor:
"Ten." "Sixty." "Twenty." "Forty five."
"Thirty two and three quarters."
"Thirty six and not a micromajig less."
"Thirty three and I'll toss in my grandmother's corpse."
"Isn't she alive?"
"Presently."
notes: Card prints COST – and 'until you or your opponent does not pay'; catalog has newer EXTRA COST: and 'you or that player'. Flavor is a dialogue, one exchange per printed line (some words bold).

name: Pinguid Bodyguard
subtitle: big enough for two
rules: If this card attacks, restore it at the end of the battle. -- This card can only attack once each turn. -- PROTECT -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains 2 life.
notes: Card prints "If this card attacks"; catalog uses newer "When" templating.

name: Purloinering Pirate
subtitle: fly the unfriendly skies
rules: This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it. -- PUSH OVERBOARD AND LOOT -- COST – Pay 1. Destroy a character you own. -- EFFECT – Put a token on this card.
flavor: Hey can I see your watch? Whoa! Look at that fish!
